title: Arch Manning and the Texas Longhorns: Leading the SEC Charge in 2025
excerpt: With the Texas Longhorns stepping into the fierce competition of the SEC, all eyes are on Arch Manning. As a member of football royalty and a rising star in his own right, Manning is poised to lead Texas into a new era. From his recruitment to his on-field leadership and team impact, this article breaks down why 2025 could be a defining season for both Manning and the Longhorns.
